name: Protected state dir
prose: deleting a folder *named* `.magentra` (or a glob/unparseable command that could hit one) always asks, in both stances; it beats the "allow deletions" setting, explicit allow rules, OVERDRIVE, and never offers "always allow". Deeper paths like `.magentra/worktrees/foo` stay routine.
invariant: An edit into a .magentra path segment or a .env* file confirms every time; broad grants and OVERDRIVE never satisfy it.
